articles.summary: Ginkgo provides an update on its third quarter financial results and the growth of its two prevailing offerings built on one autonomous lab platform: Autonomous Labs and Cloud Lab Ginkgo Bioworks Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: DNA, “Ginkgo”) today announced its results for the third quarter of 2026 that ended September 30, 2026. The update, including a webcast slide presentation with additional details on the third quarter, as well as supplemental financial information, will be available at investors.ginkgobioworks.com . Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Third quarter 2026 Revenue of $28 million compared to $29 million in the comparable prior year period, a decrease of 6%. Revenue increased from $20 million in the second quarter of 2026. Third quarter 2026 GAAP net loss from continuing operations of ($41) million, compared to ($73) million in the comparable prior year period. Third quarter 2026 Adjusted EBITDA of ($22) million, improved from ($53) million in the comparable prior year
articles.title: Ginkgo Bioworks Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results; Signs First Autonomous Lab Sale to a Top-Tier Pharma Company Novo
